equation_summary: y = ( K̄ * ( (K̄_shift * k) ⊙ v ) ) ⊙-contracted with q, concretely: k' = irfft(rfft(ssm_k_kernel)·rfft(k))[:L] + D_k·k (first causal FFT conv, shift SSM kernel); kv = k' ⊙ v (pointwise multiply over the head_dim outer-product layout); y = irfft(rfft(kv)·rfft(ssm_kernel))[:L] + D·kv (second causal FFT conv, S4D kernel); y = Σ_{d1} y ⊙ q (mul_sum contraction over the query head dim), then output_linear. Decode/step mode replaces the FFT convs with the SSMs' recurrent step on states (state_k, state). All convolutions are causal linear convs computed via rfft of size L_kernel + L.
